enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Minor Beastslayer
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a Melee Weapon to do 2 additional points of damage to Beasts.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Lesser Beastslayer
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a Melee Weapon to do 6 additional points of damage to Beasts.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Crusader
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a melee weapon so that often when attacking in melee it heals for 75 to 125 and increases Strength by 100 for 15 sec.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Demonslaying
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a melee weapon to have a chance of stunning and doing heavy damage to demons.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Dismantle
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a Weapon to cause all spells and attacks to sometimes deal 60 to 90 additional damage to mechanical creatures.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Lesser Elemental Slayer
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a Melee Weapon to do 6 additional damage against Elementals.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Fiery Weapon
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a melee weapon to often strike for 40 additional fire damage.

enchants.title: Enchant 2H Weapon - Grand Arcanist
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a two-handed melee weapon so that often when striking with a spell it restores 350 to 450 mana and increases Spell Power by 140 for 20 sec.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Grand Crusader
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a melee weapon so that often when attacking in melee it heals for 350 to 450 and increases Strength by 120 for 20 sec.

enchants.title: Enchant 2H Weapon - Grand Inquisitor
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a two-handed melee weapon so that often when attacking in melee it heals for 350 to 450 and increases Strength by 200 for 20 sec.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Grand Sorcerer
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a melee weapon so that often when striking with a spell it restores 350 to 450 mana and increases Spell Power by 70 for 20 sec.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Icy Chill
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a melee weapon to often chill the target reducing their movement and attack speed.

enchants.title: Enchant Cloak - Stealth
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a cloak to give an increase to your stealth as if you were 1 level higher.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Insight
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a Melee Weapon to have a chance to grant Insight when you cast a spell, increasing Spirit by 100% for 10 sec.

enchants.title: Enchant Shield - Law of Nature
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a Shield to add up to 30 damage to spells and up to 55 points of healing to healing spells.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Lifestealing
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a melee weapon to often steal life from the enemy and give it to the wielder.

enchants.title: Enchant Chest - Living Stats
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a piece of chest armor to increase all stats by 4, and Nature Resistance by 15.

enchants.title: Enchant Gloves - Lotus Claw
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a pair of gloves to give a small chance to acquire Death Lotus when gathering any herb in Hyjal.

enchants.title: Enchant Boots - Minor Speed
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant boots to give a slight movement speed increase.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Recovery
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a Melee Weapon to trigger Recovery when you are Parried or Dodged, healing you for 5% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more often than once every 10 sec.

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Revelation
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a Melee Weapon to have a chance to trigger Revelation when a non-periodic spell fails to critically strike. Revelation grants 100% increased critical strike chance to the next non-periodic spell cast.

enchants.n: Spell Damage +15 and +1% Spell Critical Strike

enchants.title: Enchant Weapon - Unholy Weapon
enchants.desc: Permanently enchant a melee weapon to often inflict a curse on the target reducing their melee damage.
